a35d6e9b: ;
This routine is used to queue background jobs for the Integrated Radiology (IR)
package. It sets up the necessary variables and parameters, and then calls the
%ZTLOAD utility to queue the job.
09eabd43: Save the current time in ZTDTH.
26f0a94e: If ZTIO is not defined and ION is defined and empty, set ZTIO to null string.
7aa97e54: If ZTDESC is not defined, set it to either the value of DGPGM, PGM, or 'IRT UNKNOWN OPTION'.
db18968e: If ZTRTN is not defined, set DGPGM to either DGPGM, PGM, or null string. If DGPGM is null, go to CLOSE. Otherwise, set ZTRTN to 'DQ^DGJUTQ'.
5aebcd11: Set DGZTSAVE to either DGVAR, VAR, or '*', and call the SAVE tag.
f45716b1: If DGPGM is defined and ZTSAVE('DGPGM') is not defined, set ZTSAVE('DGPGM') to null string.

90cd8c4c: Call %ZTLOAD to queue the job. If DGUTQND is not defined, print a message indicating whether the request was queued or cancelled. Set X to '^' if the request was not queued, and null string if it was queued. Go to CLOSE if the request was queued, or END if it was not.
bd268caf: Blank line.
9bc2f92b: Prompt for the device, store it in IO and IO("Q"). If the device is a queue, call the QUE tag and set POP=1 to exit. Otherwise, use the selected device.
ac410a16: Use the selected device.
a0d3bc55: Save the variables specified in DGZTSAVE in ZTSAVE. If the variable name ends with '(', save its value in ZTSAVE without the trailing '('.
07e2a048: Blank line.
55f00dfb: Replace '#' in DGZTSAVE with '(' to indicate that the following variable is an array.
85a7248c: Blank line.
3fa501a9: ;Close the device and reset variables.
ea8a0bbc: ;Kill all variables that were defined in this routine.
d72f5157: ;End of routine.
3468ebe2: ;Execute the queued task by running the routine specified in DGPGM or PGM.
947574fb: ;Kill the task and close the device.
261a0bd0: ;End of subroutine DQ.

587a47d3:  .;
 .;If the queued task has a scheduled date/time, calculate the
 .;date/time in the Y variable using the %DTC utility.
 .;DGX is the date/time in FileMan internal format.
3e99cf5c: ;End of subroutine DTQ.
